anthem.intro: A few selected lines from her birthday song, held here like a favourite verse. The full lyrics live in assets/lyrics.json.

reasons: Your smile makes ordinary days special.
You make our home brighter just by walking in.
You will always be our little princess.
Your laugh is our favourite background music.
You fight with us and then defend us like a very expensive lawyer.
You give the best advice, even when nobody asked.
Your dance moves deserve their own stage.
You remember the tiny things no one else notices.
You turn boring evenings into full-on family drama.
Your kindness shows up quietly, exactly when it is needed.
You are the family's unofficial photographer and memory keeper.
You can find snacks in any cupboard, at any hour.
You make us laugh three seconds after making us furious.
You never let us give up on ourselves.
Your courage is louder than your fear.
You are proof that little sisters grow into best friends.
You make every celebration feel bigger.
You keep every promise that matters.
The world is softer because you are in it.
Because you are you — and that is more than enough.

one_more_memory.title: One more memory...
one_more_memory.text: The best part about our story is that it isn't finished. There are still road trips to take, songs to scream in the car, and memories we haven't made yet.

paragraphs: Somewhere between the scraped knees and the late-night talks, you grew up. And somehow, you became one of the best parts of my life.
I still remember when following me around was your favourite hobby. Now I am the one taking notes on how bravely you live.
You have a way of making people feel seen. You laugh with your whole heart, love with your whole chest, and argue like a tiny Supreme Court judge.
[BIRTHDAY MESSAGE — add the words only the two of you would say here.]

This year, I hope you chase the things that light you up. I hope you are ridiculously proud of yourself. And I hope you always know that whatever chapter you are in, you have a sibling in your corner who thinks you hung the moon.

wishes.message: May this year bring you the kind of happiness you are always giving everyone else.
Keep dreaming loudly. We are always in your corner, no matter how big the dream.
Another year of us being absolutely ridiculous together. I cannot wait.
Same laughter, same nonsense, same unbreakable us. Happy 20th!
You deserve a year as warm, funny and beautiful as you are.
Our favourite notification. Our loudest cheerleader. Our girl. Happy birthday!
The house is already louder and happier because it is your birthday. Come home soon.
Twenty looks so good on you. But then again, you have always been our favourite person in every chapter.

finale.kicker: The last page is only the beginning
finale.closing: You will always be our little girl.

footer: Made with love, late nights & a ridiculous amount of glitter · Chapter 20
